title: Le Tellier to the Marquis de Castelnau, 12 May 1657

plaintext.source: None found; the King's instructions of the same date may summarise it (not checked).

transcription.notes: Measured with the clear opening lines skipped.

system.summary: Three numeric classes (plain 3-72, macron 2-53, double-prime 12-48) plus letter tokens; presumed syllabic like Le Tellier's earlier ciphers, not established.

diacritics.note: Macron and double prime mark two number classes.

system.sibling_key: Le Tellier-Colbert Ciphers 1, 1A and 2 (1650); Cipher 2 applied directly gave gibberish, the 1/1A design used as hypothesis.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: offset search with French quadgram model (offsets.py)

solution.what: Le Tellier-Colbert Cipher 2 (Dec 1650) table applied directly.
Alphabetical CV syllabary per class with one offset each; exhaustive offsets -20..79 scored by quadgrams; best is noise.

outcome.method_basis: The Le Tellier-Colbert 1650 table gave gibberish and an alphabetical-syllabary offset search on the 202-token cryptiana transcription scored as noise.
outcome.notes: Too short for an unconstrained syllabic solve; would need a known plaintext.
